semiconductor_relevance: High — AP&S International specializes in wet process equipment essential for semiconductor manufacturing, serving leading microchip and MEMS manufacturers.
summary: AP&S International GmbH is a prominent provider of chemical wet process equipment for the semiconductor industry, offering solutions for cleaning, etching, and drying processes. Their product portfolio includes both batch and single wafer equipment, designed for high throughput and optimized process performance.
capabilities: Batch and single wafer wet process machines
Cleaning and etching equipment for semiconductor substrates

regional_presence.Germany: AP&S International is headquartered in Donaueschingen, Germany.
regional_presence.United States: The company has a subsidiary in the USA.
regional_presence.China: AP&S operates a subsidiary in China.
regional_presence.Singapore: The company has a presence in Singapore.
